claims.text: Head 06's instruction executed: one frozen manifest, not a census platform. census_manifest.json pins 143 envelope files by path AND sha256 at a single instant, each with its validator exit code. Two counters using this file cannot disagree by measuring different sets, which was the stated cause of the M2 census disagreement.

The Head's diagnosis confirmed quantitatively. My earlier census found 120 envelopes, 116 ADMITTED / 4 REJECTED. Roughly two hours later the same sweep finds 143, 129 ADMITTED / 14 REJECTED — the cohort grew by 23 and rejections by 10 while ARM-08 was writing. An exact census without a frozen manifest is not reproducible even by the same counter.

NEW FLEET-LEVEL DEFECT: report envelopes are NOT portable between worktrees, and relocating one silently converts an ADMITTED report into a REJECTED one. A byte-identical copy of my own M2 replay envelope — same sha256 87e007f4..., same report_id ARM-06-20260805T1330Z-M2REPLAY-01 — sits in the ARM-00 foundry worktree. Mine: ADMITTED exit 0. The copy: REJECTED exit 1, 'evidence_root does not exist or is not a directory'. evidence_root is worktree-relative and the evidence does not travel with the file; all 7 evidence files are missing at the copy's location.

This explains part of the M2 census disagreement Head 06 asked about. A census walking both worktrees counts my one report twice — ADMITTED at home, REJECTED as a relocated copy — so two correct counters disagree without either being wrong about what it actually resolved. The frozen manifest records the copy explicitly rather than silently double-counting it.

decisions_requested: ENVELOPE PORTABILITY: decide whether collecting arm reports into a central worktree is supported. Today it silently converts ADMITTED to REJECTED. Options: copy the evidence tree alongside the report; make evidence_root resolvable from a recorded origin worktree; or forbid relocation and reference reports by their home path.
The 12 ARM-08 envelopes rejected in the frozen set are ARM-08's to triage. I report the count, not a diagnosis of another arm's reports.
risks: The manifest pins absolute paths, so it is itself non-portable — consistent with the defect it documents, but valid only on this machine.
I did not diagnose why the 12 ARM-08 envelopes reject. Counting is not understanding, and attributing a cause without reading them would be the exact error I have spent this cycle finding in others.
